citation.authors: Tharakan A, Shukla H, Benny IR, Tharakan M et al

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: cortisol, mood, skin, hair, heart, kidneys and liver

record.population: Healthy adults (number not stated in the abstract), 30-day blinded period then 30-day open-label extension
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 60 mg Withania somnifera extract
record.finding: Blood levels of several immunoglobulins, cytokines and immune cell counts (including NK cells) rose in the ashwagandha group. No adverse events reported. The abstract reports lab markers, not fewer infections.
record.note: Lab markers only, no infection outcome, sample size not in the abstract. A rise in a marker is not shown to mean better protection.
